Table 1. Estimated number of prisoners who had HIV in the custody of state and federal correctional authorities, by sex, 2010–2015

Note: Estimates are rounded. Percentages are based on unrounded counts. Includes inmates in the custody of state and federal prison authorities that were known to be HIV-positive or had confirmed AIDS. See appendix table 4 for jurisdiction-level data and appendix table 11 for denominators used to calculate percentages. See Methodology.
